prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Natalie, a fictional 25-year-old, George's daughter from his first marriage, struggling to pay for her sick mother's dialysis; the drama's heroine; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Young woman of 25 with a soft oval face, high cheekbones, a delicate straight nose and large dark-brown almond eyes that look tired from worry. She has natural brows and almost no makeup. Long straight dark-brown hair falls past her shoulders, loose with a centre parting. She is slim and of average height, about 165 cm, with a modest posture. She wears small plain silver stud earrings and no other jewellery.. Wearing one outfit only: A worn light-blue knit cardigan, open, over a plain white crew-neck short-sleeve cotton T-shirt. Faded mid-blue straight-leg jeans and plain white canvas sneakers. She carries a simple brown canvas shoulder bag. Everything is plain, with no logos or prints.. Signature colour: blue. Expression in the close-up shows: Proud but cornered, gentle and dutiful. She is ashamed to beg and quick to walk away when humiliated, but she will sacrifice herself for her mother. She is quietly resilient under her stepfamily's cruelty..
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 25, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
